images.author: Niagara
images.caption: The South Bass Island Light on South Bass Island, Ottawa County, Ohio.

brief: An island light with its keeper's house: a two-and-a-half-storey red-brick Queen Anne keeper's house with a square brick light tower rising from one corner, a black lantern with a railed gallery on top, white trim, a porch and lawn on the island's point. Two photos. Older than 1970: few post-1970 lighthouses exist (spec). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the South Bass Island Light (Put-in-Bay OH, 1897): a red-brick Queen Anne keeper's house with a square brick light tower rising at one corner to an iron gallery and lantern, a lunette in the front gable, a glassed-in porch, a stone base; a lawn on the island's point

why.note: harbour entrances on the lakes are marked by pierhead lights at the ends of the breakwaters; islands and points by a light with a keeper's house
